'''Soremaine''' is the site of a major battle of the [[Whitecloak War]].

During the engagement, the [[Children of the Light]] captured and later ransomed [[Mattin Stepaneos den Balgar]]. Though the battle was lost, the [[Illianer Companions]] "covered the field," allowing the rest of the army to evade [[Pedron Niall]]'s trap. Had the Companions not been successful, [[Altara]], [[Murandy]] and maybe even [[Illian]] might have become fiefs of the Whitecloaks, according to the musings of Niall. {{ref/book|6|9}}
